description.value: Old Abbey Ales is a small-batch craft brewery and tasting room in Abbotsford, BC, founded in 2013 and brewing since 2015, with a community-first ethos where a suggestion board on the tasting room wall shapes what ends up on tap. The brewery specializes in unconventional styles—from a chai-spiced hazy to an award-winning local raspberry sour—using Fraser Valley ingredients throughout. Cyclists travelling the Fraser Highway corridor can stop in for fresh pours of a rotating lineup that spans lagers, IPAs, and fruit sours.
